hazards.name: Borg Incursion
hazards.effect: Cube enters map; assimilates colonies and adapts.
hazards.counter: Rotate weapon types; transphasic torpedoes; coalition fleets.

hazards.name: Species 8472 Invasion
hazards.counter: Nanoprobe-enhanced weapons (requires Borg tech or alliance).

hazards.name: Crystalline Entity
hazards.effect: Strips all organic life from a planet.
hazards.counter: Graviton beam resonance (shatter it) — or hide populations in kelbonite shelters.

hazards.name: Planet Killer
hazards.effect: Neutronium hull; consumes planets for fuel.
hazards.counter: Sacrifice a ship with an overloaded warp core into its maw.

hazards.name: The Burn
hazards.effect: Most active dilithium/warp cores explode; warp travel nearly ceases.
